annotations.title: Add a rental to a cart

description: Add one rental to a real Sky High cart for a party date, delivery ZIP and hours, and get back a cart_id. Call build_quote first if the customer has not seen the price. To add more items to the SAME party, call again with the cart_id from the first call (one cart, one delivery fee). Safe to repeat: an item already in the cart is not added twice. Added is NOT reserved: nothing is held until the customer pays at checkout. Next step: prepare_checkout with the cart_id.

cart_id.description: The cart_id from an earlier add_to_cart, to add to the same cart. Leave out to start a new cart.

end_time.description: Party end, e.g. 18:00 or 6pm (default 4 hours after the start). The price depends on the length.

operating_mode.description: For a slide or combo that can run wet or dry: how the customer wants it. Ask them. Some units charge for wet use (a misting hose); the tool reports the charge.

overnight.description: true = keep it overnight, picked up after 8 AM the next morning

product.description: Product name, e.g. 'Turtle Beach water slide', when there is no product_id.

product_id.description: The product_id from build_quote or product_info. Preferred: it books exactly that product.

quantity.description: How many, default 1. A package whose name already lists its counts is quantity 1.

zip.description: 5-digit delivery ZIP (selects Houston, Austin or Dallas)
